verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions code owners or path-based ownership rules. It documents only generic 'customizable merge checks' and branch-level permissions, which are adjacent controls and do not tie required approvals to the owners of specific paths. Code-owner approval is a fair axis for a code-hosting product, so this is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an open-source-maintainer, I can require approval from designated code owners for changes to the paths they own
